profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded under the ticker STX, with headquarters listed in Singapore. It files with the SEC under CIK 0001137789. On its own site, Seagate describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and aims to bring trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

Much of the site's current messaging is about AI. Seagate says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, and that people and machines will create in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing large volumes of data. The company says it is optimizing storage for AI, with gains in capacity intended to support efficient data center architecture and buildout, and it invites organizations to assess their readiness and develop a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth.

The record held on the company lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers.
